To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Machine Learning approach for the differential expression gene expression analysis of RNA seq data is a useful and promising alternative for cancer research.
Machine Learning algorithms are able to outperform classical statistical approaches for differential gene expression analysis of RNA seq data in cancer research.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of Machine Learning algorithms for differential expression analysis of gene expression data using RNA seq.

1- To compare a classical statistical approach for differential expression analysis of RNA seq data with a Machine Learning approach for gene expression. 2- To compare the results from the previous step in terms of biological relevance. 3- To compare the performance of both approaches in terms of computational time. 4- To compare the biological relevance of both approaches in the case of a real data set.
the application of Machine Learning techniques for differential gene expression analysis of RNA seq data for a particular response (sick versus healthy).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Machine Learning approach is a powerful and useful tool to perform a gene expression analysis for a particular response.
Machine Learning based approaches are more suitable for the differential gene expression analysis of RNA seq data than classical approaches.
Machine Learning based approach is an effective and useful tool for gene expression analysis of RNA seq data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have implemented a Machine Learning algorithm for the differential gene expression analysis of RNA seq data and compared it with a classical statistical approach using a breast cancer case study.

the Machine Learning algorithm is able to select genes that are more important for the differential expression and that the classical gene expression analysis is able to select a higher number of genes that can be used for a further biological analysis.

we have developed an R package (DESeqML), which is a wrapper of a classical DESeq R package and a Machine Learning based approach (i.e. Random Forest) for differential gene expression analysis using NGS data
The main takeaway from our work is that
a Machine Learning approach is a powerful and useful alternative to a classical gene expression differential analysis for cancer research.

Machine Learning can be used to analyze transcriptome data in order to identify the most relevant genes that discriminate between two different phenotypes, and that this approach can be easily integrated in the R framework.
Machine Learning based approach is able to identify more genes that show significant differences in their expression levels associated to a particular response.
